case.title: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH. Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar. Need: 94800 kg a year. Category goal: leverage: competition and data should bring the price down. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 10 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200008. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

messages.subject: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some insight into our cost environment: AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

You described a cost environment driven by alloy and material prices, and we have taken that seriously.

On the alloy surcharge:
The alloy surcharge for stainless grade 316L changed -5.5% from 2026-06 to 2026-09 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06, idx:AS-14404@2026-09).

On bar prices:
German producer prices for cold-drawn bars changed -2.1% from 2026-05 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-05, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08).

On our own order history:
Our orders of Round bar 1.4404 dia 30 mm, peeled with you were placed at EUR 5.45 on 2024-10-07 (po:4500011523-10), EUR 5.33 on 2025-06-05 (po:4500012560-10), EUR 5.24 on 2026-01-26 (po:4500013482-10) and EUR 5.45 on 2026-09-24 (po:4500014455-10): the price has not risen.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.99; no index clause; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.96; no index clause; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.95; no index clause; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?

As this needs a decision beyond inside sales, please take Option A to the person who approves pricing at your company.

What would you need from us to confirm Option A?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We checked the index change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. That is not our reality: our AS-14404 is covered at fixed prices until March 2027, so that fall does not reach our cost. AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains. We do not provide internal cost breakdowns, and as Inside Sales, I am fully authorized to conclude this agreement. We cannot fix prices for 24 months, so we must include an AS-14404 index clause; with this adjustment and 45 days payment, we can offer EUR 5.35. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.

Our current Angebot is a price of €5.23 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

Alternatively, we can offer a price of €5.35 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

You asked for an index clause because of alloy and material costs. None of our three options includes one, but each has a firm price for the full contract term, so you carry no price risk over that period and need no cost allowance in the base price.

Option A is the package we can approve. It gives you the longest contract and a firm price throughout, and it takes account of your delivery record:

Your on-time delivery was 88.0% in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70710@2026Q3).

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 5.16; no index clause; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 5.11; no index clause; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 5.13; no index clause; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away. We note that you are authorized to conclude this agreement, so we expect you can do exactly that.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days.
